purpose: Visible semantic history for renamed, narrowed, merged or superseded research concepts. Historical objects remain inspectable rather than disappearing when the current programme vocabulary changes.

events.reason: Anna Grandori already used Epistemic Economics and Organization for an established body of work. The programme therefore moved to a narrower label that better describes its machine-abundance application without implying ownership of the prior field.

Prior-art review found strong antecedents in bottleneck, complementarity, attention, limiting-factor and induced-demand economics. The law formulation was therefore withdrawn and retained only as a narrower, falsifiable organizing hypothesis pending formalization.

The public frontier drifted away from the work actually consuming scarce attention. Attention Allocation had become the strongest falsifiable empirical programme, software/leadership capability duplicated the broader Personal Capability Practice, and Nemosyne needed an explicit independent-project boundary. The frontier was therefore realigned to one empirical programme, one capability practice and one bounded external testbed.
